title: Shared environment convergence classification and profile binding

phases.objective: Introduce one shared, mutation-free convergence contract for Staging and Production that makes environment profile selection explicit, classifies healthy release mismatch such as gateway_exact_commit as convergence drift rather than integrity corruption, returns a governed remediation handoff without applying it, and fails CI if the Staging/Production Activation Gateway policy identities or orchestrator authority boundaries drift.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The same convergence state machine binds the exact environment profile, classifies a Staging Activation Gateway exact-commit mismatch as reconciliation_required, exposes only a governed capability handoff with automatic apply disabled, verifies canonical Staging and Production Gateway policy identities, and performs no provider, database, Production, or secret mutation.
steps: Load the canonical environment convergence registry and require one shared observe-classify-plan-approval-apply-verify-certify state machine.
Bind Staging to main/local Windows Docker/activation_gateway_staging and Production to Production/Hostinger/activation_gateway without embedding provider mutation implementation in either profile.
Read the canonical Staging and Production Activation Gateway policies and require policy_key and public_host to match the selected environment profile exactly.
Feed a failed gateway_exact_commit certification check into the shared classifier and require convergence_drift plus release_identity_mismatch instead of integrity_failure.
Return activation_gateway_rollout_plan and activation_gateway_dark_deploy only as a governed profile-bound handoff with automatic_apply_allowed=false.
Feed gateway_health_reachable failure into the same classifier and keep it blocked as an availability failure rather than granting blind provider mutation.

Scan the top-level Staging orchestrators and reject Cloudflare credentials/API mutation, Wrangler deploy, or gh workflow run implementation inside them; the existing bounded Staging Worker workflow remains an explicit authority adapter rather than orchestration logic.
Emit only non-secret synthetic evidence and leave all live environments unchanged.
assertions: Staging and Production share environment_convergence.v1 and differ only through profiles, adapters, policy identity, and authority selection.
The Staging Gateway profile is activation_gateway_staging at activation-dev.mad4b.com using edge/activation-gateway/generated/route-policy.staging.json.
The Production Gateway profile is activation_gateway at activation.mad4b.com using http-generic-api/activation-gateway-runtime/generated/route-policy.json.
gateway_exact_commit is classified as convergence_drift/release_identity_mismatch and produces reconciliation_required when it is the only failed dependency check.
A governed drift advertises plan/apply capability names but cannot apply automatically and requires exact environment profile binding.
An unreachable Gateway remains blocked and does not trigger blind provider mutation.

Environment profiles contain no provider mutation implementation and the Staging top-level orchestrators contain no provider credential, Cloudflare API, Wrangler deploy, or GitHub workflow-dispatch implementation.
Release readiness requires the exact ReleaseSpec identity across all required components.
The classifier and validation path perform zero provider, database, migration, Production, ruleset, or secret mutation.

phases.objective: Wire the classification contract into AutoPilot state so repairable external drift becomes reconciliation_required or approval_required instead of an opaque terminal failure.
Move the current Staging workflow-dispatch adapter behind the shared server-governed authority protocol with resumable approval checkpoints and bounded reconciliation passes.
Exercise the shared controller against Staging live evidence while keeping Production mutation disabled.
Use the same convergence state machine with the Production profile and existing C5 authority without introducing a separate Production application or orchestrator.
